hotspots.title: Trump’s explosive NBC interview meltdown
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump abruptly ended an NBC 'Meet the Press' interview after being pressed on election fraud claims and a proposed $1.8 billion 'anti-weaponization' fund. The incident sparked widespread media coverage and social media reactions, highlighting tensions between Trump and mainstream media outlets.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-profile nature of Trump’s confrontation with the media, which fuels polarized contention and moral outrage among his supporters and critics alike.

hotspots.title: AfD’s surge in German regional elections
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to gain traction in German regional polls, leading with 27-29% support in multiple surveys. The party’s controversial statements and internal debates over extremism have fueled intense media scrutiny and public discourse.
hotspots.affect: The AfD’s rise commands attention due to its implications for German politics, evoking alarmist framing and moral panic over far-right extremism and its potential impact on EU policies.

hotspots.title: Patricia Bullrich’s rebellion against Milei
hotspots.blurb: Argentina’s Security Minister Patricia Bullrich has openly clashed with President Javier Milei over judicial appointments and policy directions, leading to internal fractures within the ruling La Libertad Avanza coalition. The tensions have sparked debates over the government’s stability and future electoral prospects.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes power struggle within Argentina’s government, which carries strong-emotion framing around leadership crises and ideological divisions.

hotspots.title: Hungary’s EU migration pact protests
hotspots.blurb: Hungary’s government, led by Péter Magyar, faces backlash over its stance on the EU migration pact, with protests erupting over perceived betrayals of national sovereignty. The issue has become a focal point for debates on Hungary’s relationship with the EU and its domestic policies.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the moral charge surrounding Hungary’s defiance of EU policies, evoking alarmist framing and polarized contention over sovereignty and migration.

hotspots.title: Vannacci’s Futuro Nazionale gains momentum
hotspots.blurb: Roberto Vannacci, a controversial Italian general, has launched the Futuro Nazionale party, drawing support from disaffected members of the Lega and Fratelli d’Italia. His rise has sparked debates over the future of Italy’s right-wing coalition and its electoral strategies.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to Vannacci’s polarizing figure and the potential fragmentation of Italy’s right-wing coalition, evoking strong-emotion framing and moral outrage.
